_comment: Roster of record for the JIVO summon agent. grantctl refuses any grant not in
'grants' and any box not in 'boxes' — so adding a machine to the fleet is a
deliberate human edit here, never something the agent can do for itself.
Every kit_path / os / operator below was READ OFF THE BOX by the inventory run
on 2026-08-22, not assumed. Boxes that were unreachable that day are listed with
what we know from ~/.ssh/config and a needs_inventory flag; the agent must not
auto_approve_everything: leave false. Setting it true removes the owner-approval
gate on EVERY grant for EVERY box, including boxes not tagged for that work.
That is the one switch here that can turn a mistake into a fleet-wide one.
THIS IS THE EXAMPLE. The live roster (real hostnames, kit paths, operator
names, SAP usernames) is deliberately NOT in git — this repo is public.
The real file lives only at /opt/jivo-summon/policy.json on the VPS and is
deployed with scp, never committed. Copy this, fill it in, scp it.

sync.summary: Pull the box's jivo-cli up to origin/main, preserving local work.

accounts-write.summary: Make the box able to create documents in SAP: sync, register the operator, verify a write-capable SAP user, prove the path with a --dry-run.
_why_gated: Auto for any box already tagged persona=accounts (see preapproved_grants) —
Daman set this up so Accounts never waits on him. Gated for everything else,
so a box that has never done Accounts work cannot mint itself write access
to the live books by asking nicely.

claude-auth.summary: Relay Claude Code OAuth to a box whose claude says 'Not logged in'.

gst-portal.summary: Enable the read-only GST portal CLI on the box.

ary.summary: Enable the read-only ARY / FR8HODBNEW distributor-DB CLI on the box.

hana.summary: Direct read-only SQL into the SAP HANA core DB (port 30015).
hana._why_gated: Raw SQL across the whole SAP core, bypassing the CLI's shaping. Daman names who gets this.

example-accounts-box.kit_path: C:\Users\<the profile the kit ACTUALLY lives in>\Documents\jivo-cli
example-accounts-box.working_profile: C:\Users\<may differ from the SSH login user>
example-accounts-box.notes: Anything that breaks an automated script here: PowerShell default shell, a Store-stub python, a non-standard profile, a laptop that sleeps.

example-dev-box.notes: Not an Accounts machine, so accounts-write is gated to Daman for it.
